artifact.table_sha256_method: sha256 over json.dumps(table, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8')
artifact.records_definition: sum of tables.*.records (provinces + province_aliases + cities + districts + living_areas + poi)

provinces.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (source compilation); administrative names are facts

coverage.covered: 17 oblasts + 3 cities of republican significance; canonical Russian names; frozen 17+3 list enforced by the importer

provinces.build_command: base tables curated from public sources on 2026-10-17 (see sources); enrichment: python scripts/import_gazetteer_csv.py --table <table> <csv>; validation: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /srv/dev/repos/jana-address/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_geo.py
provinces.notes: Kept as a flat list of strings for backward compatibility with find_province().
provinces.provenance: 17 oblast names and 3 republican cities taken from the public city list's administrative-affiliation column on 2026-10-17; the frozen 17+3 list is enforced by the importer.

province_aliases.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (source compilation); administrative names are facts

coverage.covered: every province has a Russian and a Kazakh ('... облысы') alias; find_province() only accepts aliases carrying an explicit oblast marker
not_covered: abbreviations ('обл.'), historical names, Latin region names

province_aliases.build_command: base tables curated from public sources on 2026-10-17 (see sources); enrichment: python scripts/import_gazetteer_csv.py --table <table> <csv>; validation: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /srv/dev/repos/jana-address/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_geo.py
province_aliases.notes: Additive table: provinces themselves stay plain strings.
province_aliases.provenance: Kazakh oblast forms added manually from standard administrative names; find_province() only accepts aliases carrying an explicit oblast marker.

cities.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (source compilation); city names are facts; Latin forms are project-generated

coverage.covered: 90 cities of Kazakhstan with RU canonical name, Kazakh Cyrillic and Latin aliases, each mapped to one province; districts listed for Almaty, Astana, Shymkent, Karaganda, Aktobe; 1 legacy Боралдай record retained
not_covered: official BGN/PCGN transliteration (Latin aliases are deterministic transliteration plus manual overrides)

cities.build_command: base tables curated from public sources on 2026-10-17 (see sources); enrichment: python scripts/import_gazetteer_csv.py --table <table> <csv>; validation: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /srv/dev/repos/jana-address/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_geo.py
cities.notes: Aliases are globally unique across cities (tested). Canonical Russian forms follow the baseline where they differed from the source (Караганда, Уральск, Петропавловск, Кульсары, Байконур).
cities.provenance: Parsed from the ru.wikipedia city table; canonical Russian forms normalized to baseline spellings; Kazakh spellings from the same table; Latin by documented transliteration plus manual overrides; 91st record is the legacy Боралдай entry.

districts.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (source compilation); administrative names are facts

coverage.covered: in-city districts: Almaty 8, Astana 5, Shymkent 5, Karaganda 2, Aktobe 2 (22 records), with Kazakh/Russian aliases
not_covered: districts of other cities (not verified as administrative units)

districts.build_command: base tables curated from public sources on 2026-10-17 (see sources); enrichment: python scripts/import_gazetteer_csv.py --table <table> <csv>; validation: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /srv/dev/repos/jana-address/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_geo.py
districts.notes: Duplicate-name behaviour: Aktobe has districts named 'Алматы' and 'Астана'; Astana's Алматинский district also carries the Kazakh alias 'Алматы ауданы', so city_for_district('Алматы') is deliberately ambiguous (None). District names never leak into find_city().
districts.provenance: Taken from city articles for cities with a confirmed in-city district structure; every district is mirrored in its city's districts list.

wiki-cities-ru.notes: City names, Kazakh spellings and administrative affiliation are facts; the compilation is attributed to Wikipedia and share-alike applies to derived compilations.

wiki-districts.title: City articles: Караганда (2 districts), Актобе (2 districts), Алматы/Астана/Шымкент district lists (Russian Wikipedia)
wiki-districts.notes: Karaganda: Казыбекбийский + Алихана Бокейханова; Aktobe: Астана + Алматы (2018 reform). Ust-Kamenogorsk formally has no city districts and was deliberately not populated.

osm-check.title: OpenStreetMap place nodes/ways used only to verify that named Almaty microdistricts exist (Overpass API)
osm-check.notes: No OSM geometry, tags or bulk data copied into the gazetteer; only existence of names was checked. District assignment is public knowledge, not an OSM spatial join.

osm-aksay-targets.title: OpenStreetMap target suburb ways and representative-point admin checks for Аксай 3 and Аксай 3а
osm-aksay-targets.retrieved_at_method: saved HTTP200 response filesystem mtime in UTC; exact HTTP request start was not recorded
osm-aksay-targets.notes: Independently acquired target names and representative-point administrative checks on 2026-10-18. Earlier illustrative seed history is retained, not relabeled. Point checks support city/district association, not whole-polygon containment. Other records/sources are unchanged.

sqlite.reason: 131 records load from JSON in ~0.21 ms and every resolver runs in microseconds, so SQLite would add a build step, a second artifact and schema drift for no measured benefit. Revisit only above ~5k records or if street/range queries are added.

measurements.method: time.perf_counter over 5k-20k repetitions in /srv/dev/repos/jana-address/.venv on the dev-agents VM; synthetic addresses; single process

limitations: Города покрыты только названиями и алиасами: улиц, домов, координат и геометрии нет — это не национальный адресный реестр.
КАТО/OSM-дампы не импортированы: нет официальных кодов, границ и иерархии сельских округов; источники — публичные списки, сверенные 2026-10-17.

Внутригородские районы добавлены только там, где деление подтверждено (Алматы 8, Астана 5, Шымкент 5, Караганда 2, Актобе 2); Усть-Каменогорск административных районов не имеет, остальные города не делились.
Латинские алиасы получены детерминированной транслитерацией с ручными исключениями для крупных городов; это не официальная BGN/PCGN-транскрипция.
Микрорайоны проверены выборочно по OSM (только Алматы, 12 записей): проверено существование названия, принадлежность району — по публичным знаниям без пространственного join.
Байконур записан в Кызылординскую область по источнику; город арендован РФ, юрисдикция и статус не моделируются.
Боралдай сохранён как legacy-запись ради обратной совместимости, хотя является посёлком, а не городом; в заявленные 90 городов он не входит.
Дубликаты имён: алиасы городов уникальны; POI намеренно содержит три филиала «Береке»; resolve_area/city_for_district/lookup_poi возвращают значение только при единственном совпадении.
Население, координаты, KATO и переименования после 2026-10-17 не отслеживаются; при обновлении источника MANIFEST нужно перегенерировать.

runtime.notes: app/geo.py only reads data/gazetteer.json at first use; tests/test_geo.py asserts no network imports.

privacy: No organizer addresses, ids or answers are stored. Only public administrative names and explicitly synthetic POI fixtures.
